Description

The Albany works in partnership with Lewisham Council to manage Deptford Lounge.

The Main Hall at Deptford Lounge is perfect for multiple sporting events, as well as conferences and performances.

Specifications:
- Dimensions: 17.5m x 12.2m
- Sprung wooden floor
- High ceiling
- In-built PA system
- First floor
- Price from £62ph

The building is designed for full accessibility, ensuring that all spaces on every level are fully accessible for wheelchair users. It features accessible toilets, shower facilities, and dedicated Changing Places facilities. Lift access is available to all floors, with lifts providing vocal announcements and controls at a height suitable for wheelchair users. The building was purpose-built to cater to all community members, irrespective of age, ability, or special needs, with all services designed with accessibility in mind. Additionally, assistance dogs and their owners are welcome, and a library and cafe are conveniently located on the ground floor.

To book please visit: https://deptfordlounge.org.uk/hire-us/main-hall/
